action_summary: A guard that claimed to keep forged capabilities from being proposed was appending them at score 0.0, where they survived into the ambiguity gate and vetoed decisive matches. Six lines stop a zero-score row from gating a matched one.
causal_blocker: VERIFIED_ACTION reports that an action met its own declared postcondition, and is read as 'the question was answered'. Audited: 1 of 5 verified ordinary tasks answered its question. The forged-row veto is the same error one layer down -- a surface match reported as a decisive fact.
expected_parent_change: Ordinary computer tasks that route: 11/30 -> 15/30. AMBIGUOUS 19 -> 15.
expected_parent_frontier_change: Routing coverage of ordinary tasks, in the front door. No capability registered, no family rank, no benchmark authority.
falsification_condition: If a zero-scored row is shown to be the correct answer where a positive-scored row was also a survivor, the fix suppresses a right answer and must be reverted.
measured_effect: expressible 11 -> 15 of 30; VERIFIED 2 -> 5 of which 1 of 5 answered its question by inspection; 155-row keyword census 64 -> 62 selected, A/B owed and named.
next_step: Make VERIFIED_ACTION unavailable unless the returned object is about the object the sentence named. UNJUDGED already exists in the code and is unused.

deleted_or_bypassed_paths: ADD_A_NETWORK_PERMISSION -- a premise is not an authorisation
LEAVE_UNDECIDABLE -- it was being read as false
recursive_obs.expected_parent_level_state_change: Ordinary computer tasks that route: 11/30 -> 15/30. AMBIGUOUS 19 -> 15.

delete_bypass_substitute_options: DELETE the forged append entirely -- rejected: a forged capability must be proposable when nothing else fits, which is the reason the append exists.
BYPASS by lowering DECISIVE_MARGIN_RATIO -- rejected: that would make every near-miss decisive and turn ambiguity into wrong answers.
SUBSTITUTE a tie-break on score -- rejected: a zero-score row has no score to break a tie with.
ADOPT the narrow rule: a zero-score survivor may not gate a positive-scored one.
obs_blocker.intrinsic_or_path_specific: PATH_SPECIFIC -- it is in grounded_action_v1.act(), the front door this repository actually uses, and it is triggered by any sentence whose best keyword match is accompanied by an appended forged row.
obs_blocker.surviving_causal_blocker: A row that was never a candidate decided the election, because selection refuses when the margin is undecidable and a 0.0 row makes every margin undecidable.

capability_work_deleted: no new learner invented -- settlement_v1.VersionSpace is reused unchanged
no benchmark chased -- the registry and its own sensor are the domain
no capability registered, no family flipped, no receipt minted

obs_capability.surviving_gap: No record binds (capability, observed state, outcome). macro_v1 stores only plans whose every step verified, so the system retains successes and discards exactly the negative examples that could narrow applicability.

reporting a demonstration count as a measure of learning
treating a verified success as evidence of the condition that made it possible
obs_goal.real_outcome: Owner asks whether experiencing each action once yields permanent, reusable capability.
obs_goal.surviving_necessity: Applicability must be identified before an action can be reused safely; the measurement shows one success identifies 0 of 200 conjunctive requirements.

the assumption that a declared requires list is always checkable
obs_inherited_system.fresh_reuse_plan: Any future claim that experience teaches applicability must exhibit at least one negative demonstration and show the surviving space shrinks to one hypothesis.

the sensor decision per premise is memoised by the module
obs_obs.search_stop_decision: Stopped at three candidate mechanisms because the remaining ones were measured already: breadth of environments (0/10), exposure per lesson (6/7 flat), and model-in-producer-path (forbidden).

obs_solution.losing_routes_reason: Deleting the append removes the ability to propose a forged capability at all; lowering the margin gate converts ambiguity into confident wrong answers; a score tie-break has nothing to compare.

obs_verification.synthetic_verification_necessity: The effect is measured end to end on thirty ordinary computer tasks and the 155-row keyword census, both run against the real registry on this commit. The seven tests re-run the front door rather than mocking it.

recursive_obs.required_capability: A sensor that answers UNKNOWN as its own value, so that a premise nobody can see is not silently counted as false, and a binder that either binds a stated value or reports that it cannot, never neither.
recursive_obs.why_selected_route_is_fastest_sufficient: Both are one function each, both are measured at the front door before and after, and both replace silence with an answer. Neither adds a capability, a permission, or a model.

tournament.decisive_question: Is network.http.available undecidable for any reason other than the subject parse, and does a goal that states a URL bind it?
